read_method: Arena page-fetch/search tools; not shell HTTP
scope_note: These official pages were freshly read for targeted audit findings only. They are not a full recertification of T496's 15 sports or all of its prediction prose.

sources.title: Fernandez's marathon win, Kostyuk's retirement headline Day 3 in Ningbo
sources.supports: Marta Kostyuk retired against Ekaterina Alexandrova in the second round after dropping the first set 6-4; Alexandrova advanced to the quarterfinals.
sources.excerpt: No. 3 seed Marta Kostyuk retired after dropping the first set 6-4 of their second-round match Wednesday.

sources.title: By the numbers: Jovic beats Paolini for second time to reach Ningbo quarters
sources.supports: Iva Jovic, not Marta Kostyuk, defeated Jasmine Paolini 6-4, 6-3.
sources.excerpt: No. 4 seed Iva Jovic ... defeated ... Jasmine Paolini ... The American teenager broke twice to win the opening set 6-4 ... to close out a 6-4, 6-3 victory.

sources.title: Who has the edge? Making the case for the Ningbo semifinalists
sources.supports: The official semifinal pairings are Leylah Fernandez v Marie Bouzkova and Elena Rybakina v Diana Shnaider; Fernandez had beaten Alexandrova 4-6, 6-2, 6-1.
sources.excerpt: The final four is set in Ningbo. A surging Leylah Fernandez ... will take on Marie Bouzkova in the first semifinal. In the second, top seed ... Elena Rybakina will play Diana Shnaider.

sources.title: The 2026-27 EuroLeague schedule is official
sources.supports: Official schedule article says the round-robin fixture list was released and links the full regular-season calendar. The linked calendar places Round 7 on 21-23 October and Round 8 on 27-28 October.
sources.excerpt: Round 7 on October 22 features ... Anadolu Efes facing Besiktas ... The article links the complete 2026-27 regular-season calendar PDF.

sources.title: 2026-27 EuroLeague regular-season calendar (official PDF)
sources.supports: Full official schedule lists Round 7 games on 21-23 October and the next round on 27-28 October; no EuroLeague game is scheduled on 24 October. Round 7 pairings shown there contradict BK07-BK10.
sources.excerpt: ROUND 7 21-22-23 October, 2026: 21 Oct Hapoel v Virtus; 22 Oct Maccabi v Real, Milan v Barcelona, Anadolu Efes v Besiktas, Bayern v Dubai, Partizan v Crvena Zvezda, Panathinaikos v Baskonia; 23 Oct Zalgiris v ASVEL, Paris v Valencia, Olympiacos v Fenerbahce. The next section is ROUND 8 27-28 October, 2026.

sources.title: Injury report: Round 7 — current official report
sources.supports: Official report distinguishes actual 22-23 October fixtures and their injury statuses. It says Efes absences applied to Efes v Besiktas; Fenerbahce had its full roster for the game at Olympiacos, where Olympiacos had Fournier and Dorsey out and Montero doubtful.
sources.excerpt: For Anadolu Efes v Besiktas on Thursday: PJ Dozier, Mike James, Isaia Cordinier and Georgios Papagiannis ruled out. For Olympiacos v Fenerbahce on Friday: Jean Montero doubtful, Evan Fournier and Tyler Dorsey ruled out; Fenerbahce full roster available.

sources.title: NBA Injury Report: 2026-27 Season
sources.supports: Official policy page states teams must report participation status and injury/illness/rest, and that reports are updated throughout the day; it links time-stamped 23 October reports. The portal alone is not a player-status citation.
sources.excerpt: Reports are updated on a continual basis throughout the day. Teams must designate a participation status and identify a specific injury, illness, other medical condition, or other reason for any player whose participation may be affected.

sources.title: NBA Injury Report, 23 October 2026, 4:15 p.m. ET
sources.supports: Time-stamped official game-day status snapshot 15 minutes before T496’s 20:30Z capture. Examples for T496 High NBA rows include DAL@IND Lively II and McConnell out, with Nesmith and Sheppard questionable; NYK@BOS lists Celtics player Devin Carter out.
sources.excerpt: Injury Report: 10/23/26 04:15 PM. NYK@BOS: Devin Carter — Out. DAL@IND: Dereck Lively II — Out; T.J. McConnell — Out; Aaron Nesmith — Questionable; Ben Sheppard — Questionable.
